family_name: Bradford Wall Wraps - Enviroseal Ultra Tape

spec.description:
Bradford ULTRAtape (Enviroseal Ultra Tape) is a
high-performance, linerless woven polymer fabric sealing tape designed for the
fast, waste-free joining and sealing of vapour-permeable wall wraps and roof
sarking. Engineered with a heavy-duty cold-weather adhesive and a robust woven
backing, it delivers exceptional initial grab and shear strength across
Australian climatic conditions. The linerless design eliminates release paper
waste on building sites, while the hand-tearable construction allows rapid,
blade-free installation on scaffolding and ladders.
features:
Liner-free

Hand-tearable

Forms an

Specially formulated for use with Bradford Enviroseal and Thermoseal wraps
Dimensionally stable and will not stretch out of shape during application
Low-VOC formulation compliant with Green Star building standards

Passes air barrier and water resistance
criteria

to compliant building membranes
spec.sustainability:
Linerless roll eliminates site paper waste;
low VOC formulation
install:
Ensure membrane surfaces are clean, dry, and
dust-free

Align membrane lap with minimum 150mm overlap (or 50mm if taped per
AS 4200.2)

Tear ULTRAtape to length by hand directly from the roll without
using cutting tools
Apply tape centred evenly over the lap seam

Smooth
firmly along the tape with hand pressure or a squeegee to activate the adhesive
bond
Ensure no fishmouths or air channels remain along the tape line
selection_checklist:
Confirm requirement for fast, linerless site
application (especially on scaffolding)

Verify compatibility with Enviroseal
or Thermoseal wall and roof wraps

Calculate total linear metres required for
seams and openings

Ensure application temperature is within recommended
range
limitations:
Must be applied with firm pressure to
activate adhesive
Not designed for structural mechanical holding

Should
not be left exposed to UV beyond maximum membrane exposure limits

retrieval.rag_summary:
Bradford Wall Wraps - Enviroseal Ultra Tape (Bradford ULTRAtape,
product code 471825) is an advanced 60mm x 25m linerless, hand-tearable woven
polymer tape engineered for rapid, mess-free sealing of wall wraps and roof
sarking. Formulated with an aggressive pressure-sensitive adhesive, it
eliminates the rubbish and frustration of backing paper on construction sites
while creating tough, airtight, and weather-resistant lap seals. Operating
reliably from -20°C to +80°C and fully compliant with AS/NZS 4200.2, it
accelerates weatherproofing on residential and commercial frames.
